_note: 頻道風格常數。改這裡等於改整個頻道的長相。逐字複用，不要每格重寫。
_style_ref_note: 階段 2（統一畫風）用的風格參考圖路徑，相對專案根目錄。留空則 render.py --transfer 會略過階段 2。換這張圖之前要先用 VLM venv 產生 style caption 並人工複核，見 .claude/skills/style-transfer-qwenstyle/SKILL.md

channel.tone: 輕鬆好奇——像朋友在聊，不端著
channel.positioning: 推演的樂趣為核心，不是知識傳遞

model._verified: 2026-08-03 實測跑通。兩條路徑共用 flux-2-klein-base-4b，因此畫風天然一致，不存在斷裂問題。參考圖經 ReferenceLatent 掛進正向條件，角色一致性極佳（圓頭／翹髮／圓框眼鏡／點狀眼／腮紅／赭紅毛衣全部對上）。
model._critical: 文字描述產不出一致的角色——純文字路徑畫出來的觀察者會走鐘。凡是觀察者出現的格，一律走 text_with_character，沒有例外。
model._timing: 約 40 秒／張（純文字）、48 秒／張（帶參考圖）

style_suffix: clean flat illustration with simple bold outlines and solid unshaded color blocks, no texture, no grain, no painterly brush strokes

speculation_clause._note: 推演格（is_speculation = true）才加。目的是讓觀眾分辨『這真的發生過』與『這是推測』——否則會把推測記成事實。
speculation_clause.text: rendered in a slightly desaturated cooler palette, softer contrast, as an imagined scenario rather than a documented scene

negative: text, lettering, signage text, labels, numbers, watermark, logo, split panel, split screen, diptych, collage, photo, realistic, 3d render, texture, grain, painterly, letterboxing, black bars, character standing on top of a desk or table, distorted face, deformed background people

global_bans._note: 每一格都要加進 prompt 尾端。文字禁令對本頻道特別重要——示意圖天然想要標籤，而模型寫出來的字是亂碼，比沒標籤更糟。
global_bans.text: no text, no labels, no letters, no numbers
global_bans.frame: no letterboxing, no black bars, full bleed 16:9 frame

shot_sizes._note: ★實測結論一：景別必須用『裁切位置』描述，不能用『佔畫面幾分之幾』——模型讀不懂佔比，一律畫成全身小人。整句寫進 prompt。
shot_sizes._note_subject: ★實測結論二（2026-08-06）：特寫／近景**絕對不可以把主體寫死成『臉』**。舊版寫 'the face fills the frame and is cropped just below the chin'，但本頻道的特寫格幾乎都不是拍臉（手、前臂、單一物件）。結果是 prompt 內部矛盾——同時要求『臉填滿畫框』與『兩隻手掌填滿畫框』——模型兩個都畫一半，於是憑空多出一張臉佔住畫面中央，真正的主體被擠到旁邊。6 格特寫有 5 格這樣壞掉。換成 {subject} 佔位後，s59／s62／s24 三格同 seed 對照，臉全部消失、主體填滿畫框，三格三勝。所以這兩條含 {subject}，由 framing.subject 填入英文主體短語，compose.py 會擋下沒填的格。
shot_sizes.特寫: extreme close-up, {subject} fills the entire frame from edge to edge and is cropped by all four frame edges
shot_sizes.近景: close-up, {subject} fills most of the frame and is cropped by the left and right frame edges
shot_sizes._note_pose: ★中景／全身是人體語彙。中景**只畫得下上半身能表達的姿態**——躺、跪、盤腿、斜靠、走動這類全身姿態寫進中景格，模型會直接退回全身景（實測：s05／s26／s27／s28／s32／s39／s67／s70 全部如此，且拿掉『腳踝／膝蓋』這類詞也救不回來，因為問題出在姿態本身而不是個別觸發詞）。選景別時見 storyboard-framing 的『景別與姿態相容』。
shot_sizes.中景: medium shot, the subject is cropped at the waist by the bottom edge of the frame, the top near the upper edge
shot_sizes.全身: full shot, the whole body from head to feet, the head near the upper edge and the feet near the lower edge
shot_sizes.遠景: wide establishing shot, the environment dominates and the subject stands small in the middle distance

compositions.三分法: rule-of-thirds composition with the subject on the {left|right} third
compositions.對角: diagonal composition with the action direction aligned to the diagonal
compositions.雙人: two-shot with the subjects split left and right on the thirds
compositions.留白: large negative space with the subject small in one corner
compositions.透視: single-point perspective composition with strong leading lines converging toward a distant vanishing point

layouts._note: 圖解詞彙。示意圖／並置／序列用這一組，疊加在 compositions 之上。
layouts.置中單體: a single central element isolated on a plain background
layouts.左右分欄: two elements placed side by side, one on the left half and one on the right half
layouts.上下堆疊: elements stacked vertically, the upper one above the lower one
layouts.環形: elements arranged in a circular loop
layouts.流程帶: elements arranged left to right as a horizontal progression

info_hierarchy.主體突出: the main element large, saturated and sharply outlined; secondary elements smaller, desaturated and set back
info_hierarchy.均等比較: both elements the same size and weight so neither dominates

directionality.由左至右: arrows and motion flowing from left to right
directionality.匯聚: arrows converging toward a single point
directionality.發散: arrows radiating outward from a single point

contrast_balance.對稱: the two sides balanced and symmetrical, an equal comparison
contrast_balance.失衡: one side visually dominating the other in size and weight
